notes.title: Additional notice:
notes.content:
The VEGAS Movie Studio 14 Steam Edition also includes Music Maker 2017 Steam Edition, allowing you to produce your own music and create custom soundtracks for your videos. Get inspired and discover a collection of 5,000 sounds for Dubstep, Hip Hop, Techno, Deep House, Jazz and Rock Pop.
